nodes.description: Ownable._owner: address private owner of the contract, controls onlyOwner gated functions.
ERC20._balances: mapping(address=>uint256) token balances updated in _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20._allowances: nested mapping of spender allowances written by _approve.
ERC20._totalSupply: total token supply mutated by _mint and _burn.
ERC20._decimals: uint8 token decimals used to compute the 1e9 token supply.
Funganomics.presale: PresaleUnlockedType holding presale wallet, funding address, percentages, token_rate, max_buy_limit, token_sold and is_started.
Funganomics.public_sale: UnlockedType with address and 40 percent unlocked allocation.
Funganomics.liquidity_and_exchanges: UnlockedType with address and 5 percent allocation.
Funganomics.team_locked: LockedType of team addresses, 9 percent and 24-month lock timestamp.
Funganomics.makt_and_pship_locked: LockedType of marketing/partnership addresses, 11 percent and 12-month lock.
Funganomics.company_reserve_locked: LockedType of company reserve addresses, 5 percent and 12-month lock.
Funganomics.staking_locked: LockedType of staking addresses, 10 percent and 6-month lock.
Funganomics.blacklist: dynamic array of addresses blocked from transfers, appended by add_to_blacklist.
Funganomics.amount_spend_per_user: mapping tracking wei spent per buyer to enforce max buy limit.
Funganomics.presale_purchased_per_user: mapping of total tokens purchased per address.
Funganomics.presale_received_per_user: mapping of tokens actually received per address.
Funganomics.month: private constant-like uint256 (2628000 seconds) used to derive lock timestamps.
Context._msgSender: internal view returning msg.sender.
Ownable.owner: public view returning _owner, used by onlyOwner modifier.
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function that moves ownership to newOwner.
ERC20.transfer: public entry that delegates to internal _transfer.
ERC20.approve: public entry that delegates to internal _approve.
ERC20.transferFrom: public entry that calls _transfer and decrements allowance.
ERC20.increaseAllowance: adds to the caller allowance via _approve.
ERC20.decreaseAllowance: subtracts from the caller allowance via _approve.
ERC20._transfer: internal balance movement with zero-address and balance checks.
ERC20._mint: internal supply-increasing mint that updates _totalSupply and _balances.
ERC20._burn: internal supply-decreasing burn that updates _totalSupply and _balances.
ERC20._approve: internal allowance write with zero-address checks.
Funganomics constructor: initializes locked wallet arrays and mints the 1e9 token supply to unlocked and locked allocations.
Funganomics._transfer override: adds blacklist check and timestamp lock checks for locked allocations before moving balances.
Funganomics.buyToken: payable presale purchase computing token amounts, updating accounting and forwarding ETH to the funding address.
Funganomics.predict_token_value: view computing tokens for a given wei amount using presale.token_rate.
Funganomics.changeTokenRate: onlyOwner setter for presale.token_rate.
Funganomics.startPresale: onlyOwner flag setter for presale.is_started.
Funganomics.endPresale: onlyOwner flag setter clearing presale.is_started.
Funganomics.change_max_buy_limit: onlyOwner setter for presale.max_buy_limit.
Funganomics.add_to_blacklist: onlyOwner loop pushing addresses into the blacklist array.
Funganomics.get_blacklist: public view returning the whole blacklist array.
Funganomics.filter_blacklist: private view looping over the blacklist to test membership.
Funganomics.buy_allowance_left_by_user: view returning max_buy_limit minus wei already spent by an address.
Funganomics.Airdrop_for_presale: onlyOwner loop transferring tokens to a list of addresses and crediting presale_received_per_user.
Funganomics.Airdrop: unrestricted public loop transferring tokens from msg.sender to arbitrary addresses.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, blacklist, purchase accounting and airdrop transfers.
block.timestamp: miner-influenceable time source used to gate locked allocation transfers and to initialize lock times.
payable(presale.funding_address).transfer(msg.value): ETH push to a configurable address inside buyToken.
_transfer(presale.presale_wallet, msg.sender, transfer_amount): token payout in buyToken executed after accounting but relying on presale wallet balances.
presale.max_buy_limit - amount_spend_per_user[_address]: subtraction whose result is compared against msg.value.
(amount_in_wei*presale.token_rate)/(10**18): multiplication and division in predict_token_value.
blacklist.push(address_array[i]): unbounded storage array growth performed by owner.
Airdrop loop calling _transfer(msg.sender, address_array[i], amount_array[i]) with no access restriction.
for loop over blacklist in filter_blacklist: gas-unbounded iteration on every transfer, enabling denial of service.
locked_timestamp < block.timestamp requires inside _transfer override: timestamp-dependent transfer gating.
(percent_locked*supply)/(100*address_locked.length) mint arithmetic in the Funganomics constructor.
predict_token_value parameter amount_in_wei: wei amount converted to tokens.
changeTokenRate parameter tokens_with_decimals_per_eth: new presale token rate.
change_max_buy_limit parameter new_buy_limit_in_eth: new per-user maximum wei spend.
add_to_blacklist parameter address_array: addresses to append to the blacklist.
filter_blacklist parameter _address: address tested for blacklist membership.
buy_allowance_left_by_user parameter _address: buyer whose spent amount is read.
Airdrop_for_presale parameter address_array: recipient list for the owner airdrop.
Airdrop_for_presale parameter amount_array: token amounts credited to each recipient.
Airdrop parameter address_array: recipient list for the public airdrop.
Airdrop parameter amount_array: token amounts sent to each recipient.
Funganomics._transfer parameter sender: source address checked against locked allocations and blacklist logic.
Funganomics._transfer parameter recipient: destination address of the balance update.
Funganomics._transfer parameter amount: token quantity moved between balances.
buyToken local total_transfer_amount: token quantity derived from msg.value and added to presale.token_sold.
buyToken local transfer_amount: immediate 25 percent unlock portion computed from total_transfer_amount.
Funganomics constructor local supply: 1000000000*(10**_decimals) used for all mint calculations.
filter_blacklist local is_exist: boolean membership result set inside the blacklist loop.

tokens_with_decimals_per_eth is the sole input written to presale.token_rate by changeTokenRate.
new_buy_limit_in_eth is the sole input written to presale.max_buy_limit by change_max_buy_limit.
